NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 23, 10:21 AM ET

Puka Nacua is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 24.4 DraftKings points for $8,400, at Las Vegas. Amon-Ra St. Brown (19.1, $7,800) and Drake London (17.7, $7,500) are next.

Puka Nacua is also the top value at the position: 2.90 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 23, 10:21 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 7

Puka Nacua, LAR at LV ($8,400)

Puka Nacua carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 24.4 DraftKings points at $8,400, the 2nd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 5.3 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 11.6 targets on 33.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.90 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Nacua averaged 24.4 points with a simulated floor of 11.8 and a ceiling of 46.0, and he holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs GB ($7,800)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 19.1 DraftKings points at $7,800. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 34.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.45 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations Brown averaged 19.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.4 and a ceiling of 39.3, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 28.25 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Drake London, ATL vs SF ($7,500)

Drake London projects 3rd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $7,500. The model gives him 8.2 targets on 27.1 routes. The salary works out to 2.35 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 28 at the position. Across 100,000 simulations London averaged 17.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 37.9, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 2.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 49.5.

Value: Matthew Golden, GB at DET ($6,000)

Matthew Golden projects for 16.4 DraftKings points at $6,000, which works out to 2.73 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 28 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 7.8 targets on 32.7 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Golden averaged 16.3 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 36.3, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Green Bay is a 3-point underdog on the road against Detroit, with an implied team total of 25.25 in a game totaled at 53.5.
